commits.author: Kevin Kouomeu
commits.message:
🚀 Refactor Book and Author classes, Rename Packages

- Split classes to reduce instance variables
- Added BookRefacto and AuthorRefacto classes
- Renamed packages for clarity and organization

Refactored `Book` and `Author` into `BookRefacto` and `AuthorRefacto` to adhere to the principle of no class having more than two instance variables. Also, reorganized packages to improve code maintainability. This ensures cleaner, more modular code structure.

commits.author: 1kevinson
commits.message:
🚀 Refactor class names and error handling

- Renamed `Practice` to `Service`
- Replaced `addFlash` with `throwException`
- Updated `Employee` class usage

This commit improves clarity by using more descriptive class names. Additionally, it changes error handling in `Authentication.java` to throw an exception instead of adding a flash message, thereby improving error management and making the codebase more maintainable.

commits.author: 1kevinson
commits.message:
🚀 Rename Board to Grid for naming consistency

- Renamed `Board.java` to `Grid.java`
- Updated method `displayBoard` to `displayGrid`
- Renamed `BoardValid.java` to `GridValid.java`

These changes were applied to enhance clarity and maintain consistent naming conventions within the codebase, making it more intuitive and aligned with the grid-based terminology used in the project.

commits.author: Kevin Kouomeu
commits.message:
✨ Refactor Distance toKilometer method

- Change method to return new Distance object
- Fix incorrect unit conversion
- Maintain immutability of Distance objects

commits.author: 1kevinson
commits.message:
🚀 Add Wallet and WalletValid classes without getter/setter

- Introduce Wallet class with simple balance management.
- Create WalletValid class with custom methods for business logic.
- Both classes handle BigDecimal for financial calculations.

These changes introduce two new classes: Wallet and WalletValid, designed to manage financial balances. Wallet includes traditional getter and setter methods, while WalletValid omits setters in favor of custom methods (`increaseMoney` and `totalAmount`) to align with specific business rules.

commits.author: 1kevinson
commits.message:
🚀 Add valid implementations for clean code practices

- Add classes following clean code principles
- Refactor existing classes with improved structure
- Ensure better readability and maintainability

This commit introduces new classes and refactors existing ones to adhere to clean code practices, such as minimizing indentation levels, avoiding the use of 'else', ensuring single responsibility, and better structuring. These changes improve the overall code readability, maintainability, and follow best practices for clean and efficient code architecture.

commits.author: 1kevinson
commits.message:
🚀 Add authentication and JWT support

- Implement JWT-based authentication
- Add User entity and repository
- Create AuthenticationController with login and signup

This commit integrates JWT-based authentication into the project. It includes creating the `User` entity, implementing `UserRepository`, and setting up the `AuthenticationService` and `JwtService`. These changes provide secure user management and token-based authentication for the application.

commits.author: Kevin Kouomeu
commits.message:
🚀 Initialize Maven project with basic structure

- Add primary App class
- Include unit test for App class
- Configure Maven with pom.xml

This commit initializes a new Maven project, adds a basic "Hello World" application, and includes a simple unit test for it. The `pom.xml` file is configured to manage dependencies, ensuring the project is ready for development and testing.

commits.author: Kevin Kouomeu
commits.message:
🛠️ Adapt error handling with exceptions

- Throw exceptions for validation errors
- Remove unnecessary comments
- Clean up unused imports

The main adjustment involves replacing return statements with exceptions to handle validation errors. This ensures that registration will not proceed if any validation fails, making the code more robust. Unnecessary comments and imports were also removed to streamline the code.

commits.author: Kevin Kouomeu
commits.message:
🚀 Remove redundant comments from pom.xml

- Deleted two unnecessary dependency comments
- Improved readability of the pom.xml
- No impact on functionality

The comments referring to the Maven repository URLs for dependencies were removed to clean up the pom.xml file. These changes enhance the readability of the configuration, making it easier to manage without affecting the build process or functionality.

commits.author: Kevin Kouomeu
commits.message:
🚀 Introduce User Registration with Guard and Supporting Files

- Add User guards for registration validation
- Include Maven dependencies in pom.xml
- Create .gitignore for local files

This commit introduces `UserRegistrationWithGuard` to enhance user input validation using helper methods in `UserGuard`. Additionally, it configures essential dependencies in `pom.xml` for project management and includes a `.gitignore` file to keep the project directory clean. These changes aim to improve code organization and validation logic.

Renamed project files and packages from `jwt-tuto` to `auth-jwt-api`. Updated `application.yml` with MySQL configurations and replaced PostgreSQL dependency with MySQL in `pom.xml`.

Updated the main application class and test class names for clarity and consistency. This change should make the purpose and usage of these classes more understandable.

Added basic Spring Boot application structure with `JwtTutoApplication`, Maven wrapper files for consistent build environment, and initial dependencies in `pom.xml`. Included a `.gitignore` to exclude unnecessary files from version control.

commits.message:
🔄 Removed UserController, added UserDto, enhanced tests

Removed UserController.java as part of a codebase cleanup effort. Introduced new UserDto.java and updated ProjecionsTest.java with additional checks. Further enhancements include adjusted inspection settings and adding full name to the UserView interface.

commits.author: 1kevinson
commits.message:
🗑️ Remove SQL scripts and tweak test setup

The SQL scripts (`delete.sql` and `insert.sql`) were deleted from the project. The setup in `ProjectionsTest.java` was adjusted to create fewer test users, and an additional assertion was added in the `testFetchUserByEmailServer()` method to verify the user's email.

commits.author: Kevin Kouomeu
commits.message:
Remove Address entity and adjust related code

The Address entity was removed from the project, resulting in adjustments to the User entity and related tests. Also, new SQL scripts for data manipulation were added. This is part of a refactoring effort to simplify the user management model.

commits.author: Kevin Kouomeu
commits.message:
Add User entity and related files, update project settings

Implemented the User entity along with necessary repository, service, and controller classes. Improved the project setup by updating asset files and the dependencies in pom.xml. Also, renamed 'application.yml' to 'application-test.yml' for better clarity. Optimized the project for PostgreSQL database use.

commits.author: Kevin Kouomeu
commits.message:
Update JDK version and reconfigure application settings

The ProjectRootManager component in the misc.xml file is updated to use JDK 20 from JDK 11. Additionally, the database configuration settings initially located in the test directory application.yml file have been moved to the main directory. The Postgres dependency has also been added to the pom.xml file.
